status: Method revision after review of prior data and some new data; not blind preregistration.
size_average: Arithmetic mean of measured D90 and D108 at each theta; Ref-style diagnostic only. Do not call it a thermodynamic plateau without size convergence.

late_beta0_diagnostic.reason: Eight patterns with early-window time diagnostics failing, plus uniform_A control; expansion chosen using size/window/model sensitivity, not proximity to equilibrium.
late_beta0_diagnostic.relative_denominator: abs(c at L144 in the same late window, log_plus_inv1)
late_beta0_diagnostic.role: Separate diagnostic only; does not replace the common L108 theta2-6 main series or its stability label.

diagnostics.denominator: abs(c at L108, theta 2-6, log_plus_inv1) for every stability metric
diagnostics.sign_rule: Any zero or sign change versus the main coefficient among L90 main, L108 2-5, L108 3-6 or L108 four-parameter 2-6 fails the stability diagnostic.
diagnostics.D_size_comparison: Report unshifted pointwise absolute/relative D90-D108 and maximum differences; no new D threshold or automatic plateau declaration.
diagnostics.meaning: Current finite-window coefficient stability diagnostic, not an equivalence theorem, asymptotic proof, confidence interval, or pure-corner classification.

reporting: Retain all patterns and failed or missing diagnostics.
Compare pure log and corrected estimators on exactly the same observations.
No error bars: these are deterministic calculations, not statistical replicates.
Equilibrium coefficients are a post-analysis comparison, never a target for window selection.
A small raw D difference need not imply a small fitted coefficient difference.
Whole-source hashes identify each executed snapshot; final coverage applies only to explicitly required beta values.

controlled_window_selection.status: Posthoc method revision after viewing early-window results; not independent blind validation.
controlled_window_selection.denominator: abs(c108 of the individual candidate window under log_plus_inv1)
controlled_window_selection.trim_rule: At L108 delete exactly the first or the last measured canonical-grid point and refit log_plus_inv1; each trimmed fit must have at least five points.
controlled_window_selection.nested_model_rule: The four-parameter log_plus_inv1_inv2 fit must have at least six points.
controlled_window_selection.sign_rule: c90, c108 four-parameter, and both L108 trimmed fits must have the same nonzero sign as c108 main.
controlled_window_selection.selection_order: Among qualified candidates choose largest theta_min, then largest theta_max. No equilibrium coefficient is used.
controlled_window_selection.empty_result: No stable candidate; never fill from a failed fit.
controlled_window_selection.interpretation: Local-window diagnostic only; not a final reliable corner-coefficient list. Endpoint deletion and local model agreement do not establish an asymptotic regime. Not a statistical confidence interval.

model_order_diagnostic.status: Additional posthoc diagnostic requested after examining locally stable but drifting corrected estimates.
model_order_diagnostic.minimum_points: parameter_count + 2; five-parameter model requires at least seven observations
model_order_diagnostic.size_drift_denominator: abs(c108 in the same window and same model)
model_order_diagnostic.window_drift_denominator: abs(c108 in window4-8 for the same model)
model_order_diagnostic.order_drift_denominator: abs(c108 in the same window under the four-parameter model)
model_order_diagnostic.interpretation: Report every combination, including strong size pollution, sign changes and poor conditioning. No selection or qualification is based on this diagnostic.

data_relocations.reason: Move validated observations and controls out of obsolete analysis-result directories without changing values.
